info.title: Tavrix Menu API
info.description:
Tavrix Menu backend API.

Production and staging clients must send real Clerk JWTs with Authorization: Bearer <clerk-jwt>.

Development can use dev tokens only when NODE_ENV=development.

Development auth header example:

Authorization: Bearer dev:user_tavrix_owner;email=owner@tavrix.local;name=Tavrix%20Owner

programId.description: Optional when the business has exactly one active program.

phone.description: Required Iraqi mobile number in local 07xxxxxxxxx or international +9647xxxxxxxxx format.

intent.description: JOIN creates a new customer and membership only when the phone and email are unused. RECOVER always requires a future verified recovery flow and never returns card access from contact details alone.

cardToken.description: Opaque public card reference already held by the trusted browser. It is validated but never logged or stored in plaintext.

transferToken.description: Dedicated one-time loyalty card transfer token. Staff wallet scan QR values are not accepted.

token.description: Opaque value read from a supported loyalty wallet barcode.

pushToken.description: Sensitive APNs push token supplied by Apple Wallet.
